package.name: calib_bringup
package.description: Root launch entry point for calib_ws: brings up a full hand-eye calibration session end-to-end -- camera, apriltag detection, easy_handeye2's calibrator UI, the real arm stack (fp3_moveit_server, from franka_demo_ws). The arm is never moved automatically: poses are set by hand and samples taken from the rqt calibrator.
